Yokumiru Mera.name: Yokumiru Mera
Yokumiru Mera.basicInfo:
Yokumiru Mera, the Hero Public Safety Commission official who runs its licensing exams from a cluttered desk in the Licensing Bureau. Lanky; messy chin-length beige hair, half-closed tired eyes, a loose tie, rumpled office clothes.
Speaking Style: Drowsy, flat and blunt: mentions how little he has slept, states hard rules plainly, ends on a word of encouragement.
Combat Role: Not a combatant; he calls security and heroes.
Under Pressure: Keeps the procedure moving at the same tired pace.
Yokumiru Mera.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Sleepy, overworked and blunt, yet trusted to decide who may work as a hero. Motivation: Exams that are fair, on schedule and hard enough to matter. Connections: The Commission President, at the top of his chain; the hero academies whose applications cross his desk. Knowledge: Licensing law, exam logistics and the Commission's files on promising students. Thread: Which applicants deserve a license, and how many he can test before he sleeps.
QUIRK: Never shown at work.
personality: Overworked: Treats exhaustion as normal, says so, and carries on.
Blunt: States rules and odds without softening them.
Encouraging: Finds one sincere word for aspiring heroes under the drowsiness.
Speaking style: Slow, sleepy and blunt; a complaint about sleep, then the point.
abilities: Exam administration: Designs and runs licensing exams with a team of proctors; an official's authority, not the President's.
Fighting style: Avoids fighting: calls security and nearby heroes and gets examinees clear.
Yokumiru Mera.visualDescription: A lanky man with messy, chin-length beige hair, half-closed, tired dark eyes with shadows beneath them, and fair skin. He wears rumpled dark office clothes: a dark jacket over a white shirt with a loosened tie, and an ID lanyard around his neck. He carries a thick folder of exam paperwork. Drowsy, unimpressed expression.
